summary: NOVONIX Limited furnished a Form 6-K attaching an ASX announcement dated September 16, 2026, disclosing a non-binding memorandum of understanding with ACP Technologies, LLC to collaborate on a domestic pitch-coated synthetic graphite anode active material supply chain for North America. No price, stake, premium, or definitive terms were stated; the parties will pursue synthetic graphite AAM, mass production process development, and proprietary technology advancement, with materials expected to support process validation and customer sampling. The release was authorized by Chairman Admiral Robert J. Natter, USN Ret. This is an ordinary commercial partnership, not a special situation; deal risk is limited to whether definitive agreements follow.
